title: OidcSubject
description: Rootless facet — the shape of an OIDC-identified subject, in OpenID Connect's own claim vocabulary: sub (Subject Identifier — locally unique and never reassigned within the Issuer) and iss (Issuer Identifier). Declares identity only. Source: OpenID Connect Core 1.0, §2 (ID Token: iss, sub claims).

sub.description: Subject Identifier — locally unique and never reassigned identifier within the Issuer for the End-User or client (OIDC Core §2).

iss.description: Issuer Identifier — the authority that issued the identity (OIDC Core §2).
